inherits_from.what: Every edge a verb with a distinct named inverse; symmetric edges banned; a path must read as a sentence.

language_rule: Every type and verb carries `pt`, so the vocabulary can travel to pt.newsroom.sgit.ai without being rewritten.

node_types.label: Article
node_types.definition: One commissioned op-ed, as published on worldnewsday.org and frozen here. The prose is linked, never reproduced.

node_types.label: Author
node_types.definition: A named person in an article's byline, in their professional capacity. Name and the role line they gave; nothing else, and never a contact detail.

node_types.label: Organisation
node_types.definition: An organisation an author's own role line names. Derived from that line, never typed by hand.

node_types.label: Theme
node_types.definition: A theme from the published lexicon whose pattern matched the article's prose. It says the piece contains those words and nothing more.

node_types.label: Cited source
node_types.definition: A page an article links out to. The evidence the piece offers its reader, counted as the piece offers it.

node_types.label: Licence
node_types.definition: A statement of republication terms. Carries the form it takes: prose, a named public licence, or a machine-readable declaration.

node_types.label: Snapshot
node_types.definition: A dated capture of the source site: every page fetched, frozen to bytes in this repository, and hashed.

node_types.label: Frozen file
node_types.definition: One frozen file with its SHA-256. The thing a claim walks back to.

banned.why: Symmetric, so it would be its own inverse, and it says nothing a reader could walk.
Every edge in a graph built from text mentions something. It is the absence of a verb.
The verb reached for when the relationship is unknown. Find out, or leave the edge out.
Two pieces touching the same theme is not agreement. Asserting agreement would be this section putting words in an author's mouth.

formulas.note: The only classification this graph makes rather than reads. Each edge carries the words the pattern matched, and the gate re-runs every pattern on the frozen bytes in both directions.
